entries.name: WorkBuddy
entries.one_liner_zh: 一张安静的书桌：今日的事情放在一边，把「帮我做这件事」一步一步走完。
entries.one_liner_en: A quiet desk: today’s tasks on one side, and a short “help me do this” you can step through.

entries.name: DramaWave
entries.one_liner_zh: 竖着读三则原创的微场景。点一下，或轻轻一滑，就到下一拍。
entries.one_liner_en: A vertical reader for three original micro-scenes. Tap or swipe to the next beat.
